device.name: NYAN BT Image Controller
device.notes: BLE-only variant of the LOY SPACE protocol (identical to AUTOBABA LED Backpack). Vendor-confirmed white-label reskin of the LOY SPACE platform with BLE-only mode (no Wi-Fi): NYAN's own product page tells users to download the LOY space app for the same backpack. BLE device name starts with "YS" or "TL". Wire frame (hardware-verified by samrodrigues/loy-space-protocol and icedac/open-loyspace): BLE writes carry an outer u16-LE total-length prefix, then the inner frame [0xAA, 0x55, 0xFF, 0xFF, len (u16-LE), sno (u16-LE), flags (0xC1), subflag, ...payload, checksum (u16-LE)]. Every frame ends with a 2-byte additive checksum (sum of the preceding bytes & 0xFFFF, little-endian); the device silently rejects bad checksums. Notifications omit the outer prefix. Commands are JSON objects app-side, serialized to binary TLV opcodes on the wire — the JSON text itself never crosses the link. Image/program upload is GIF89a streamed in 960-byte chunks (a 24-bit BMP encoder exists app-side as a conversion artifact, but BMP is not the wire format). Resolution: vendor documents 64x64 (backpack) and 16x16 (leg bag). Chunked at ~180 bytes per BLE write. Backend: store-cdn.popled.cn. rt_draw (real-time pixel draw), game and pwd (password) are shared LOY SPACE platform opcodes (indices 32/31/42 in the platform app's 45-entry dispatch table), not NYAN-specific additions. Vendor ecosystem active: NYAN GEAR app updated 2025-12-04, vendor store selling, backend CDN live. CONFIDENCE: HIGH — service/char UUIDs, name prefixes and command JSON verified in the uni-app app-service.js bundle (serviceId 0000FFF0, WriteId 0000FFF2, NotifyId 0000FFF1; rt_draw/game/pwd/dev_info/del_all/value_fix tokens present); wire framing cross-checked against two independent hardware-verified RE repos.

credentials.notes: Anything within radio range can connect and issue commands. Physical proximity is the only access control.

factory_reset.effect: No credential state to clear. Power-cycling drops the current connection, which is the actual remedy for the common failure mode: the device already being connected to another central.

steps.action: Remove power (or battery) for a few seconds and reapply.
steps.expect: Device advertises again and accepts a new connection.

methods.description: No provisioning step: the device advertises as soon as it is powered on and accepts a connection from any central. There is no account, no network credential exchange and no pairing PIN, so a replacement client only has to scan, connect and write.

steps.action: Power the device and scan for its advertisement.
Connect and run the documented initialization sequence, if the spec defines one.

setup.notes: No provisioning. Shares the LOY SPACE controller lineage with the AUTOBABA backpack, including the YS advertising name prefix.

rejoin.notes: Nothing binds this device to a network or an owner, so switching controllers is just connecting from the new one. If the old client is an Android or iOS phone, remove the device from the OS Bluetooth list as well — a cached bond can keep the phone reconnecting automatically and holding the single available link.

characteristics.name: Notify
characteristics.notes: NotifyId in app-service.js. NOTIFY-only — writes go to FFF2 (write-without-response); enable the CCCD before writing or frames are not ACKed. Notifications carry the 0xAA55 inner frame without the outer u16-LE length prefix used on writes. Hardware-verified by samrodrigues/loy-space-protocol.

game_command.description: Game-mode command (shared LOY SPACE platform opcode, dispatch idx 31). JSON: {"cmd":{"game":{...}},"sno":N}

play_program.description: Play programs. JSON: {"cmd":{"pgm_play":{"model":0,"ids_pro":[1..60]}},"sno":N} — ids_pro is the full 60-slot program-id array; an "index" key is not corroborated.

rt_draw.description: Real-time pixel draw (shared LOY SPACE platform opcode, dispatch idx 32). JSON: {"cmd":{"rt_draw":{...}},"sno":N}

set_password.description: Set / send device password (shared LOY SPACE platform opcode, dispatch idx 42). The simple string form {"cmd":{"pwd":"..."},"sno":N} is not corroborated — the platform builds typed pwd payloads with an appended hash.

characteristics.name: Write
characteristics.notes: WriteId in app-service.js. Write-without-response is mandatory (regular writes hang). App-side commands are JSON objects wrapped as {"cmd": <command>, "sno": <sequence>}, but the wire payload is binary TLV opcodes — the app serializes JSON to TLV before send. Each write carries an outer u16-LE total-length prefix and every frame ends with a 2-byte additive checksum (sum of the preceding bytes & 0xFFFF, LE); the device silently rejects bad checksums.
